March 9, 2022

A note to our community.

Putin’s war on Ukraine is an attack on democratic values — values core to Figma’s vision of making design accessible to all. We are blessed with the incredible diversity and international composition of our team and the larger Figma community and we see very clearly the pain that Figma’s Ukrainian community is going through.

Our internal community of Figmates has been making contributions to organizations supporting Ukrainian refugees and humanitarian relief and we are matching those contributions as part of our donation matching program. We are also granting continued access to Figma’s paid features for our current Ukrainian customers who ask for assistance in the coming months.

At the same time, we are complying fully with the requirements of U.S. and EU sanctions against Russia. We are also stopping all new sales efforts in Russia.

We pray for our community’s safety and an end to this aggression soon.

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)![](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/672d9533efa16607fd9f84281a4d158c6a9fd048-400x400.jpg?w=400&h=400&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)

Dylan Field is the co-founder and CEO of Figma. Dylan studied computer science and mathematics at Brown University where he and his co-founder, Evan Wallace, first started experimenting with design tools built on (and for) the web. With funding from a Thiel fellowship, they began Figma. Prior to Figma, Dylan interned at O'Reilly Media, LinkedIn, and Flipboard.
